name: LimeLight Lemonade Jam
original_name: ライムライト・レモネードジャム
source:
Music, friends, and love.
From the day he met her, the world began to shine—

[url=/c153631]Okinami Yukitaka[/url] was skilled at bass but had never belonged to a specific band.
He had no goals, yet nothing else he wanted to do.
Amidst his aimless musical pursuits, he stumbled upon a street performance that would completely transform his monotonous daily life.

There stood a girl, [url=/c153623]Harumi Ena[/url], challenging herself with a solo performance of singing and guitar playing, with her complete amateur skill.

The moment Yukitaka witnessed her street performance, his ordinary world began to sparkle once again.

[Translated from [url=https://www.yuzu-soft.com/products/lllj/index.html#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
音乐、朋友和爱。
从遇见她的那天起，世界就开始闪耀——

[url=/c153631]Okinami Yukitaka[/url] 擅长贝斯，但从未属于特定乐队。
他没有目标，但也没有其他想做的事。
在漫无目的的音乐追求中，他偶然发现了一场街头表演，彻底改变了他单调的日常生活。

那里站着一位女孩，[url=/c153623]Harumi Ena[/url]，以完全业余的技巧挑战自己的歌唱和吉他独奏表演。

当幸隆目睹她的街头表演的那一刻，他平凡的世界再次开始闪闪发光。

[翻译自[url=https://www.yuzu-soft.com/products/lllj/index.html#story]官网[/url]]
